problem: Return-to-site was scheduled only by single-job push; an event/reconnect catalog read could display complete without running completion navigation
Eight failed SSE attempts exhausted reconnect after about 24 seconds
A silently stalled response had no idle deadline
fix: Reconcile completion consistently from both single-job push and catalog synchronization for the tracked task
Bound continuous SSE reconnect by five minutes, exponential backoff capped at four seconds
Ten-second connection/first-data deadline and forty-five-second stream inactivity deadline; heartbeat bytes reset inactivity, without querying task state
Preserve authentication cleanup and cancel old subscriptions; manual checkbox changes and a new task cancel outdated navigation

regression_reproduction.case: Backend completes while the final job push is lost; resource-event catalog read reaches complete but original page does not return

controlled_browser.driver: Real embedded HTTP/session store and filesystem notifications with controlled restore driver
cases: Final job push lost; resource catalog completion still returns automatically
36-second network outage exceeds old eight-attempt limit, reconnects without user refresh or state polling
Silently held SSE response replaced after missing heartbeat; state resynchronized
Continuous outage stops within finite five-minute retry window, with no task-state queries
controlled_browser.time_controls: 36-second outage uses real browser time; inactivity and five-minute exhaustion use the browser clock

rollout: Core embeds portal/app.js; user must restart their normal Core and reload the page to load the fix. Existing completed task must not be submitted again.
limits: No access to the existing user browser connection; two deterministic client defects reproduced separately
Full replacement was run only in the owned development fixture; Linux and production are not accepted by this run
